address: 20 Ghim Moh Road Market & Food Centre, #01-54, Blk 20, Ghim Moh Road, 270020, Singapore
bio: This stall founded in 1959 is a household name! Its lovingly hand-made chwee kueh – toothsome rice cakes topped with dried radish and mildly spicy sambal – are hugely popular among locals. Minimum order of four pieces....
